Case ID: FIR_036 NEW CASE DOCUMENT: FIRST INFORMATION REPORT FIR No.: FIR_2026_00036 Date: 16/12/2012 Police Station: Vasant Kunj South, New Delhi Reporting Officer: Sub-Inspector Rajesh Kumar Case Reference: NIRBHAYA_DEL_2012 INCIDENT REPORT: On the night of 16th December 2012, a 23-year-old female (identity withheld per victim protection norms) and her male companion boarded a privately operated charter bus (vehicle DL1PC0149) at Munirka bus stand, New Delhi, at approximately 21:30 hours. Six male occupants of the vehicle subjected the victim to a brutal gang assault.

All findings require investigator verification before any action is taken.
